meaning_and_rules: Permanent ID: BRAND-MODEL-TRIM-KWH[-AWD][-6S][-BAAS]. Join key for all files.
Row ID in the master XLSX (can change; do not join on it).
Ex-showroom, without wall charger. BaaS rows = chassis price; battery is a separate loan.
verified = official; corroborated = 2+ independent sources; pending = unconfirmed (say so to user).
Maker certified range; see range_standard. Never use alone for usage fit.
Lower bound of maker's own real-world claim (Tata C75 / Mahindra 'real-world'). Not independent.
Independent test (Autocar India). Preferred for usage fit when present.
Tested if efficiency_basis='Independent test', else estimate from maker claim.
At default blended tariff ₹9.4/kWh. Recompute with user's tariff: tariff / efficiency.
price + charger (if not included) + electricity at 40 km/day for 5 years. Excludes insurance, registration, service, resale, offers.
Average DC power derived from maker charge time and window. Comparable across brands.
Minutes of DC charging to add 100 km.
Cost to add a 7.2 kW wall box if not included; see charger_basis for whether it's official or assumed.
Bharat NCAP. 'Rated, coverage unconfirmed' = rating exists but may not cover this version.
Auto-generated warnings; must be shown with any recommendation.
Electronically adaptive dampers per maker. 'Not stated' is common: never infer ride quality from it.
Unladen, as stated by maker. Blank = not stated.
Clearance under the battery pack where the maker states it. Blank = not stated.

Allowed values: pricing_type: BaaS/battery included; price_status: corroborated/pending/verified; drive: AWD/FWD/Not stated/RWD; esp: Not listed/Not stated/Yes; adas: L2/L2+/None/Not stated; camera: 360°/540°/Not stated/Rear camera/Sensors only; sunroof: None/Not stated/Openable panoramic/Panoramic/Sunroof; ventilated_front: No/Not stated/Passive only/Yes; adaptive_suspension: No/Not stated/Yes; battery_warranty: 8 yrs / 1.6L km/Lifetime (1st owner)/Not stated; ncap_status: Not stated/Not tested/Rated, applies/Rated, coverage unconfirmed; charger_included: No/Not stated/Unclear/Yes (3.3 kW)/Yes (7.2 kW); body_type: Hatchback/SUV/SUV coupé/Sedan; efficiency_basis: Independent test/Maker real-world claim (estimate)/None
Blank = not stated by any source. Treat as unknown: never pass or fail a filter on it silently.
from_variant_key__TO__to_variant_key. Battery-included variants only, sorted by price within model.
Gains no accessory can replace. Use for 'what you give up' wording.
BRAND-MODEL-NAME. Genuine accessories only; aftermarket excluded by policy.
Only 'yes' items may be suggested to cover a missing factory feature, and never as equal to the higher variant.
Equivalence ratings are analyst judgement, not maker data.
